child.text:
[{"insert":"Hanging Knee Tuck

50 total reps of the hanging knee tuck in as few sets as possible. The hanging position requires grip and shoulder stability, while the core does the work. Break the reps however needed, but keep rest short between sets. The goal is to accumulate all 50 with quality.  Hips should flex fully on each rep, and the legs should lower with control rather than dropping.
"}]
